instruction: Adjust Chrome settings to automatically clear all browsing data—including history, cookies, and cache—right after each tab is closed.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not support automatically clearing browsing data immediately after closing individual tabs. While Chrome can clear data on exit and has incognito mode, the specific behavior of clearing data after each tab closure is not a built-in feature that can be configured.
